responses.value: Buyers likely aren't coming back for refills because they can't find them in stores. I'd compare refill sales in stores that stock refills with those that don't.
Keep: only 20% of stores stock refills, and where they do, refill sales match plan.
Refill sales per lipstick in stores that stock refills against those that don't. If they're no higher where refills are stocked, I'd drop it.
